quick: Solution 100 to 1000 IU/mL applied to the bleeding surface, or powder sprinkled (per product)
summary: Thrombin is applied topically to stop capillary oozing during surgery, alone, on gelatin sponge, or as part of fibrin sealant. It must never enter the circulation: intravascular thrombin can cause fatal thrombosis.
indications: Topical haemostasis of minor bleeding from capillaries and small venules during surgery

dosage.d: Solution 100 to 1000 IU/mL applied to the bleeding surface, or powder sprinkled (per product)

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Converts fibrinogen to fibrin at the bleeding surface.

absolute: Bovine thrombin: known antibodies to bovine thrombin or factor V

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk

serious: Bovine thrombin: antibodies causing factor V deficiency and severe bleeding on re-exposure

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
